CorsOrigin.description: An origin, written as a browser sends it (scheme, host and port, no trailing slash), several of them, a pattern, or a function asked about each.

lastModified.description: Enable or disable `Last-Modified` header. Uses the file system's last modified value.

control.description: Enable or disable setting `Cache-Control` response header.

immutable.description: Enable or disable setting `Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable` response header for immutable assets (i.e. asset with a hash in file name like `image.a4c12bde.jpg`).

mime.description: How a file's media type is decided.

types.description: Allows a user to register custom mime types or extension mappings.

default.description: Allows a user to register a default mime type when we can't determine the content type.

mimeTypes.description: Allows a user to register custom mime types or extension mappings.

mimeTypeDefault.description: Allows a user to register a default mime type when we can't determine the content type.

writeToDisk.description: Allows to write generated files on disk.

methods.description: Allows to pass the list of HTTP request methods accepted by the middleware.

headers.description: Allows to pass custom HTTP headers on each request

publicPath.description: The `publicPath` specifies the public URL address of the output files when referenced in a browser.

stats.description: Stats options object or preset name.

serverSideRender.description: Instructs the module to enable or disable the server-side rendering mode.

outputFileSystem.description: Set the default file system which will be used by webpack as primary destination of generated files.

index.description: Allows to serve an index of the directory.

modifyResponseData.description: Allows to set up a callback to change the response data.

lastModified.description: Enable or disable `Last-Modified` header. Uses the file system's last modified value.

cacheControl.description: Enable or disable setting `Cache-Control` response header.

cacheImmutable.description: Enable or disable setting `Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable` response header for immutable assets (i.e. asset with a hash in file name like `image.a4c12bde.jpg`).

forwardError.description: Enable or disable forwarding errors to next middleware.

hot.description: Enable hot module replacement over a Server-Sent Events or WebSocket endpoint.

transport.description: How events reach the clients: `sse`, `ws` (needs the optional `ws` dependency and an HTTP server to answer upgrades on, given as `server` or through the middleware's `attach` method), a function building a transport of your own, or `{ server, client }` when yours speaks one of the two built-in protocols so the bundled client can still be injected.

server.description: The transport this middleware serves the stream with.

client.description: Which of the built-in protocols your transport speaks, so the bundled client can still be injected.

path.description: The path the endpoint is served at. Must start with a slash and carry no query string or fragment.

heartbeat.description: Heartbeat interval (in milliseconds) used to keep the connection alive.

server.description: HTTP server the `ws` transport answers upgrades on, when it is already built. Otherwise hand it over later with the middleware's `attach` method.

progress.description: Publish compilation progress events to the clients.

token.description: A secret the injected client carries and the endpoint requires, so reaching the stream takes something a page has to have been given rather than a header the browser may not send. `true` mints one per run, a string uses that one — for a client of your own that has to build the url itself — and `false` requires none. Defaults to `false`, because requiring one would refuse a client this middleware did not inject; `true` in the next major release.

cors.description: Which origins may read the Server-Sent Events endpoint from a page on another one. Local origins only by default. `true` grants every origin, which lets any site the developer has open read the build's errors, including the source frames webpack puts in them.

origin.description: Which origins may read it, as Vite and `expressjs/cors` are configured.

statsOptions.description: Deprecated, do not use, will be removed in the next major release. Use the `stats` option instead, which decides whether a payload carries errors and warnings.

inject.description: Add the hot client entry and HotModuleReplacementPlugin to the compilation. Turn it off to wire them yourself.

url.description: Where the browser connects. Defaults to the endpoint's own `path`; may be an absolute url for an endpoint reached on another origin or through a proxy, and carries its own `token` in that url when that endpoint requires a different one.

name.description: Limit the runtime to one compilation's builds. Defaults to the compilation's own name.

overlay.description: Show build problems and uncaught runtime errors in an overlay.

indicator.description: Show an indicator while a rebuild is in progress: `true` and `circular` a badge, `linear` a bar across the top of the viewport.

hmr.description: Apply a build through Hot Module Replacement.

liveReload.description: Reload the page on a build that changed something, when `hmr` is off.

reloadOnFailedUpdate.description: Reload the page when an update cannot be applied.

urlParamPrefix.description: Prefix of the page-url parameters that turn `hmr` and `liveReload` off for a single page.

logging.description: How much the runtime logs to the browser console.

reconnect.description: How many times to reconnect before giving up.

timeout.description: How long the runtime tolerates silence before reconnecting, in milliseconds.

autoConnect.description: Connect as soon as the entry runs.

dynamicPublicPath.description: Prefix the endpoint path with the bundle's public path at runtime.
